name: hbox
summary: Horizontal layout container that arranges children left-to-right with uniform separation. Use for toolbars, button rows, label+control pairs, top navigation, status bars overlaid on chain_render_wall. Children auto-size via Container size flags. Pair with VBoxContainer for grids and nested layouts. Alignment controls horizontal packing (BEGIN/CENTER/END) when children's total width is less than the container.
example_tscn_snippet:
[node name="MyHBox" type="HBoxContainer" parent="."]
offset_right = 480.0
offset_bottom = 40.0
alignment = 1
theme_override_constants/separation = 12
